claims.claim: Project Skills Orchestrator installs and verifies governed GitHub Copilot workspace capabilities with safe rerun behavior.
The registry-free runtime composes configuration, templates, schemas, and authoritative reports.
The implementation uses Node JavaScript modules, PowerShell, Bicep, and JSON schemas.
Forty-one governed skills, transactional adoption, and ownership rules provide bounded automation without command conflicts.
Contributors create or adopt projects through the command line and inspect results with inventory and verification commands.
Skills own bounded actions, prompts own distinct guided experiences, and instructions enforce clarification and approvals.
The governed workflow clarifies, plans, executes approved actions, validates, and records handoff while external operations remain gated.
Version 1.1.0 passes local validation, while production distribution remains blocked on cross-platform, signing, and independent-review evidence.
